summary.text: Thomas West is the Democratic candidate for Ohio State Senate District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A social worker, he represented District 49 in the Ohio House of Representatives from 2017 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Thomas West received a master's degree in social work administration and a bachelor's degree in social work from the University of Akron.
He served in the Ohio House of Representatives, District 49, from 2017 to 2022.
In the 2021-2022 session his committee assignments included the House Finance Committee, the House Health Committee and the Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee.
